name: Onna Kyoushi Mania
source:
Main character Shinji has feelings for his female teacher. In order to satisfy his desires, he invents a plan how to insult and train teachers and students in the school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公真司对他的女老师抱有感情。为了满足自己的欲望，他制定了一个计划，要凌辱和调教学校里的老师和学生。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
